# PurDentix Notebook (purdentix.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for PurDentix, a once-daily chewable tablet (30 per bottle) marketed to support the oral microbiome, gum wellness and fresh breath in adults. Supplement Facts (per tablet): inulin powder (chicory root) 100 mg; proprietary probiotic blend 40 mg (3.5 billion CFU at manufacture): Lactobacillus paracasei, Lactobacillus reuteri, Bifidobacterium lactis BL-04, Lactobacillus salivarius; other ingredients microcrystalline cellulose, tricalcium phosphate, sucralose, organic peppermint leaf, magnesium stearate; CONTAINS MILK. Directions: 1 tablet daily. Bundles: 1 bottle $69 plus $9.99 shipping, 3 bottles $59 each ($177, free USA shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free USA shipping); 60-day money-back guarantee subject to the seller's terms.

IMPORTANT: PurDentix is a supplement, not a treatment for cavities, gum disease or bad breath, and it does not replace brushing with fluoride toothpaste, cleaning between teeth or dental visits; no study of the tablet is shown. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Contains milk; probiotics need care with weakened immunity. Facial swelling, throbbing pain with fever, loose teeth, bleeding gums or a mouth sore over two weeks need a dentist. Adults 18+ only; not for pregnant or nursing mothers per the label.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
